cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(rtklib_consumer C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# CMakeDeps (generated by the test_package recipe) provides rtklib-config.cmake
# with the imported target rtklib::rtklib pointing at the installed
# include/ and lib/ of the package under test.
find_package(rtklib CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_executable(rtklib_consumer test_consumer.c)
target_link_libraries(rtklib_consumer PRIVATE rtklib::rtklib)
